description: Take-home pay for a gross yearly salary in a country (and region or city, for regional and municipal taxes), with every tax line, the model's caveats and its official sources. Takes age, children, a pension share, a newcomer regime, and a partner (joint filing for a married couple where the country has it).

age.description: Age in years, where the tax uses it

children.description: Children's ages, for child credits and allowances

city.description: City id or name; sets country, region and municipal taxes

country.description: ISO alpha-2 or name; optional when city is given

currency.description: Currency of gross; default the country's

partner.description: A second earner in the same household

gross.description: Their gross yearly salary, in the same currency as gross; 0 for a spouse with no pay

spouse.description: Married or registered partners: joint filing where the country has it

regime.description: A newcomer regime id for this country (list_metrics_and_sources kind "regimes")

region.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision, e.g. US-CA, GB-SCT, IT-21

flatRate.description: Flat income tax rate replacing the schedule, e.g. 0.24

noSocialContributions.description: You pay none of the country's employee social contributions, e.g. a foreigner on a Singapore Employment Pass pays no CPF

taxableShare.description: Share of gross that is taxable, e.g. 0.5 under an impatriate regime

name: net_pay
title: Take-home pay
